name: Performance Adviser
description: Finds what makes Spotify's Home page stutter and offers reversible fixes: removes sticky-header blur and scroll-time card tooltip churn, applies runtime CSS patches that park idle :has() rules, names the snippet or theme responsible, and includes a profiler. 27.7 -> 72.0 fps in testing.

name: Liquid Lyrics Revival
description: Community-maintained Spicetify lyrics extension forked from NMW's Liquid Lyrics. Smooth word-by-word synced lyrics, fullscreen lyrics, romanization, and an expandable sidebar card.
